SASBDB entry SASDTX4  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDTX4/)

Rabbit skeletal muscle G-actin with ATP and Ca2+, in-house SAXS, 5 mM Tris, 0.1 mM CaCl2,
1 mM NaN3, 0.2 mM ATP, pH 8.05, 20 C.
Publication: Ryzhykau Y et al., Biochem Biophys Res Commun 2023, DOI 10.1016/j.bbrc.2023.149340.
Files:
  experimental_data/SASDTX4.dat    SASBDB intensities file (q in A^-1)
  SASDTX4_fit1.fit                 SASBDB fitting file (CRYSOL, q in A^-1; chi2 1.037)
  SASDTX4_fit1_model1.pdb          SASBDB model (identical to PDB 3HBT)
  3HBT.pdb                         files.rcsb.org/download/3HBT.pdb (ATOM/HETATM columns 1-54
                                   compared equal to the SASBDB model; nothing modified)
Audit 2026-11-13: the paper (Ryzhykau et al. 2023) was read: buffer G (0.2 mM ATP, 0.1 mM CaCl2,
1 mM NaN3, 5 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.05, Sec. 2.1) and chi2 1.037 with 3HBT (Sec. 3.1) confirm the entry;
temperature and wavelength are in its Table S1 (not available) and are SASBDB's.

Round 5 rescan (2026-11-13): verdict KEEP, see notes/new-entries/AUDIT5-A.md.
